recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, symmetrical head-and-shoulders studio portrait of a woman with voluminous brunette hair, set against a dark, neutral background. The lighting is soft and frontal, emphasizing facial features and hair texture. Typography is anchored in the lower-right quadrant, utilizing a tiered hierarchy of high-contrast serifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry of the subject versus asymmetrical placement of text
Warm skin tones against a cool, dark charcoal background
Sharp, geometric letterforms contrasting with soft, organic hair textures
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer
Voluminous, layered hair framing the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, close-up crop from chest up, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary focal point, with the white text block acting as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then follows the hair flow to the text block in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, flat background surrounding the head, providing high contrast for the hair edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background and dark brunette hair tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, luminous skin tones and honey-blonde highlights in the hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin/text and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated ascenders in the primary display line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' features a deep, rounded descender hook
The 'A' has a sharp, pointed apex

anatomy.strokeCharacter: Uniform vertical stems with hairline horizontals
Consistent with display font but less condensed

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast Didone serif for names paired with a wide-tracked geometric sans for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like alignment of text edges

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and condensed nature of the primary name.
Classic high-contrast serif for a sophisticated look.
Ideal for the wide-tracked lowercase secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered studio portrait of a woman with long, wavy brunette hair and honey highlights, looking directly at the camera. Soft beauty lighting, dark charcoal background, chest-up crop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of white text in the bottom right corner. Line 1: Large, condensed high-contrast serif in all caps. Line 2: Medium-sized high-contrast serif in all caps with wider tracking. Line 3: Small geometric sans-serif in lowercase with very wide tracking. All lines right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the primary font a high-contrast serif?
Is the subject looking directly at the camera?
Is the background dark and neutral?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text line
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the artist name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the eyes or mouth.
Check that the white text is legible against the hair highlights.
Verify the three-tier typographic hierarchy is distinct.
Confirm the portrait is symmetrical while the text is offset.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Dark background + Right-aligned Didone typography
